Notation: μ := H^{n+1}⌞M = μHE[n+1].restrict R.carrier with M = R.carrier; ξ := R.orient; B ∈ ℝ the bound with ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ B for all x; e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 and e_l♭ := innerSL ℝ e_l for l ∈ Fin P; β∧γ := alternatizeUncurryFin(β.smulRight γ). MultiVector P (n+1) carries the operator norm, so |L(γ)| ≤ ‖L‖‖γ‖ (`ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm`).

1. (Strongly measurable version of ξ.) ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for μ (field `R.aestronglyMeasurable_orient`). Let ξ₁ := `R.aestronglyMeasurable_orient.mk R.orient`; then ξ₁ is strongly measurable (`AEStronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurable_mk`) and ξ = ξ₁ μ-a.e. (`AEStronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk`).
2. (Truncation.) S := {x : ‖ξ₁(x)‖ ≤ 1} is measurable, since x ↦ ‖ξ₁(x)‖ is strongly measurable real-valued, hence measurable (`StronglyMeasurable.norm`, with the type `β := MultiVector P (n + 1)` given explicitly, then `measurableSet_le`). Let ξ₀ := ξ₁ on S and ξ₀ := 0 off S (`S.piecewise ξ₁ 0`). ξ₀ is strongly measurable (`StronglyMeasurable.piecewise`) and ‖ξ₀(x)‖ ≤ 1 for every x (on S by definition, off S because ‖0‖ = 0).
3. (Coefficient forms.) For l ∈ Fin P put A_l(x) := e_l♭∧ω(x) ∈ Λ^{n+1}. A_l is continuous: x ↦ (e_l♭, ω(x)) is continuous, (β, γ) ↦ β.smulRight γ is a bounded bilinear map (`isBoundedBilinearMap_smulRight`), and alternatizeUncurryFin is a continuous linear map (`ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM`, `alternatizeUncurryFinCLM_apply`). Hence A_l is strongly measurable (`Continuous.stronglyMeasurable`; ℝ^P is second countable), the pair x ↦ (ξ₀(x), A_l(x)) is strongly measurable (`StronglyMeasurable.prodMk`), and since evaluation (L, γ) ↦ L(γ) is continuous (`isBoundedBilinearMap_apply`), c_l(x) := ξ₀(x)(A_l(x)) is strongly measurable (`Continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable`), hence measurable.
4. (The field.) Define W(x) := Σ_{l ∈ Fin P} c_l(x)·e_l. W is Borel measurable as a finite sum of measurable real functions times constant vectors (`Finset.measurable_sum`, `Measurable.smul_const`).
5. (Vanishing.) If ω(x) = 0 then e_l♭.smulRight 0 = 0 and alternatizeUncurryFin 0 = 0 (evaluate with `alternatizeUncurryFin_apply`), so A_l(x) = 0, c_l(x) = ξ₀(x)(0) = 0 for every l, and W(x) = 0.
6. (Bound.) For all l and x: ‖A_l(x)‖ ≤ (n + 1)·‖e_l♭.smulRight ω(x)‖ (`ContinuousAlternatingMap.norm_alternatizeUncurryFin_le`) = (n + 1)·‖e_l♭‖·‖ω(x)‖ (`ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply`) = (n + 1)·‖ω(x)‖ (‖e_l♭‖ = ‖e_l‖ = 1 by `innerSL_apply_norm` and the norm of `EuclideanSpace.single`) ≤ (n + 1)·B. Hence |c_l(x)| ≤ ‖ξ₀(x)‖·‖A_l(x)‖ ≤ (n + 1)·B, and ‖W(x)‖ ≤ Σ_l |c_l(x)|·‖e_l‖ ≤ P·(n + 1)·B =: c' (`norm_sum_le`, `norm_smul`).
7. (Almost-everywhere identification.) By the sibling orient_tangent (Lean `Submission.fvmb_imrep_ae_unitOrientation_approxTangentPlane P (n + 1) U R`), for μ-a.e. x, ξ(x) is a unit orientation of T_xM := approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x. Intersect this full-measure set with {ξ = ξ₁} (step 1) and fix x in the intersection. By the sibling orient_norm (Lean `Submission.unit_orientation_norm_le_one`), ‖ξ(x)‖ ≤ 1, so ‖ξ₁(x)‖ = ‖ξ(x)‖ ≤ 1, x ∈ S, and ξ₀(x) = ξ₁(x) = ξ(x). Therefore W(x) = Σ_l ξ(x)(e_l♭∧ω(x))·e_l, which is exactly the vector V of the sibling wedge_vector (Lean `Submission.dor_lmbsf_ll_wedge_representing_vector P n (R.orient x) (ω x)`) for ζ := ξ(x) and α := ω(x). Part (1) of that sibling gives ξ(x)(β∧ω(x)) = β(W(x)) for every 1-covector β, and part (2) with Q := T_xM gives W(x) ∈ T_xM.
8. (Conclusion.) W and c' satisfy all four requirements: W is Borel measurable (step 4), W(x) = 0 whenever ω(x) = 0 (step 5), ‖W(x)‖ ≤ c' for all x (step 6), and for μ-a.e. x, W(x) ∈ T_xM and ξ(x)(β∧ω(x)) = β(W(x)) for all β (step 7). ∎
